node.statement: Apply lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity to the commutative algebras D_r and C, their projection bases from node 1.1, and the sufficiently accurate non-unital inclusions v_D,w established there. Its exact conclusion is a linear bijection S_{v(I_r),Q}->direct-sum_{a=1}^r S_{R_a,Q}; consequently dim S_{v(I_r),Q}=sum_a d_a=r*d.
